title: ProMQA-Assembly: Multimodal Procedural QA Dataset on Assembly

prompt.location: Appendix Figure 11 (benchmarking prompt example: parts image, task graph in DOT, sampled frames, question); Figure 12 (LLM-judge prompt)
prompt.note: 'We slightly adapted the prompt for each model. Refer to our code attached.'

claim.metric: LLM-judged score (0-100), all questions, multimodal input, reasoning effort medium
claim.location: Table 6, Multimodal block, row GPT-5 w/ think, column All
claim.judge: llm:gpt-4o (snapshot unstated; gpt-4o-2024-11-20 is the GPT-4o used elsewhere)

data.source: ProMQA-Assembly (646 QA pairs, released for evaluation only) over Assembly101 recordings (access by request)

notes: 20 uniformly sampled frames at 640x360 per question plus the parts image; the authors report API cost under 1 USD per model. o3-mini is only compared as an annotation generator (Sec. 3).

resolution.plan: Figure 11 shows the benchmarking prompt but Appendix C.1 says it was 'slightly adapted' per model with the details in the attached code; the frame sampling (20 uniform frames from the end, 640x360) and the parts image are also produced by the code. Take the prompt and sampling from the repository, run gpt-5-2025-08-07 with reasoning effort medium on the 646 questions, and judge with GPT-4o using the Figure 12 prompt (0-100 scale).
resolution.approximation: The frames come from Assembly101 recordings, which are obtained under a data-use agreement rather than an open download; the GPT-4o judge snapshot is unstated.
